title: 第98章 那是来时路第97章 日子突然更有盼头了
slug: 快递通两界我带华夏全民修仙
content_zh:
李婉从窗户跃出，脚尖点在粉杏花瓣上，几个来回就到了她和木青练剑之地。
自从第一次在此处遇见后，之后李婉每日来此练剑都能遇见木青，不过二人虽未言语，却格外默契。
来此的时间只有偶尔的重合而并无冲突，往往是早上木青先练李婉后练，而晚上则是相反。
李婉跃入空地之上，回忆起落婴谷和那女修的对峙时的感受。
某些东西就是当你还在屏障之外的时候，七窍心智都被蒙在厚厚的浓雾中，明明已经有了风向，却不知该往何处突破。
但一旦进入过屏障一次后，所有的路程就变得清晰可明起来。
李婉练剑也是同样的道理。
她身姿肆意，剑随心动，每一次的动作都蕴含着如水波般内秀的能量，在能量积攒到阈值后，能量在灵力的催动下，发生了某种变化。
能量外化成白色的灵光挥落在头顶，细密的雪花从头上飘下。
粉杏花瓣被剑气激荡，纷纷扬扬落下，应和着李婉头上飘下的大雪，仿佛是为她的成功赞礼。
李婉收剑，身上再次被雪落了一身白，她并不为此厌烦，反而喜悦这样的变化，这证明她又一次蜕变，变得更强。
她沉浸在刚刚练剑的余韵中。
刚刚那招，如果是在木青的剑阵里，破开她剑阵的速度，应该可以比上次的蛮力破阵时快两倍，美感也会更上一层楼。
如果现场有第三人的话，肯定会为她的帅气惊叹。
什么莽夫劈柴？
哼，胡扯！
那叫她的来时路！
李婉打算将千里一式彻底巩固凝实后，再开始练习千里二式。
无论是练剑还是修行，都和起房子一样，需将地基打牢固了，再往上摞砖石，这样等房子变高变大时才不会坍塌。
她坐在花瓣和雪地铺就的软毯之上，掏出纸笔，记下此刻的练剑的心得和感悟，也记下在万象楼中得到的心法寒九霄。

前面的一切都没问题，但当李婉想提笔想写下寒九霄之时，心尖突然一痛。
一股巨大的恐慌笼罩在心头，她的六感告诉她，如果继续写，将会发生什么她无法承受的可怕后果。
这是源自灵魂深处的警示。
笔尖顿下，不再尝试继续往下写。
作为东地第一大宗，香炉宗的很多东西都令李婉惊叹，但若说截至目前为止，李婉印象最深刻的是什么。
那必然是法阵。
香炉宗之中，法阵随处可见，招收新弟子的问心境是法阵，宗门头顶终日环绕着阵环，那个阵环的作用必然不止作为大门那么简单，万象楼中依旧是法阵。
在李婉没有触及的地方，必然也到处遍布着法阵。
李婉没有上帝视角，没有足够多的信息对比香炉宗和流林宗两个宗门谁的法阵能力更强。
但从自己能破开流林宗宗门禁制传递信息，想将寒九霄记录在纸上却引动灵魂警示来看，香炉宗在法阵禁制的造诣，恐怕要远胜流林宗。
但自己之前分明将课程中所学内容写下寄出，此举却并未引动她的任何不适。
是因为她写下的授课内容，虽来自课堂，但是其中却施加了许多她个人的间接思考之故么？
上次寄快递时，她正在犹豫是让老家人改混沌心法、天源真诀，还是五行心法，所以还没将天源真诀寄回，所以才未引发警示。
李婉将一只手撑在下巴上，眉眼轻蹙，一时理不清其中的区别，却不再尝试将香炉宗的功法传回。
地星的安全大于任何资源，之后任何和香炉宗相关的快递，她都会慎之又慎。
content_en:
Li Wan jumped out of the window, her toes resting on the pink apricot petals, and after a few trips back and forth, she reached the place where she and Mu Qing were practicing swordplay.
After meeting here for the first time, Li Wan met Mu Qing every day when he came here to practice swordsmanship. However, although the two did not speak a word, they had a tacit understanding.
There are only occasional overlaps in the time here but no conflict. Mu Qing usually practices Li Wan first in the morning and then the opposite in the evening.
Li Wan jumped into the open space and recalled her feelings during the confrontation with the female cultivator in Luoying Valley.
Something is that when you are still outside the barrier, your mind is covered in thick fog. It is clear that the wind direction is coming, but you don't know where to break through.
But once you've entered the barrier once, the journey becomes clear.
The same goes for Li Wan's sword practice.
Her posture is wanton, and her sword moves with her heart. Every movement contains energy as beautiful as water waves. After the energy accumulates to a threshold, the energy undergoes some kind of change under the stimulation of spiritual power.
The energy turned into white aura and fell on the head, and fine snowflakes floated down from the head.
The pink apricot petals were stirred by the sword energy and fell one after another, echoing the heavy snow falling on Li Wan's head, as if to praise her success.
Li Wan sheathed her sword and was covered in white again by the snow. She was not bored by this, but was happy with this change, which proved that she had transformed again and became stronger.
She was immersed in the afterglow of her sword practice.
If the move just now was used in Mu Qing's sword formation, the speed of breaking through her sword formation should be twice as fast as the last time she broke through the formation with brute force, and the beauty would be even higher.
If there were a third person present, they would definitely be amazed by her handsomeness.
What kind of fool is chopping firewood?
Humph, nonsense!
That's where she came from!
Li Wan planned to completely consolidate the Thousand Miles One Form before starting to practice the Thousand Miles Two Form.
Whether you are practicing swordsmanship or spiritual cultivation, it is the same as building a house. You need to lay a solid foundation and then pile bricks and stones on top so that it will not collapse when the house becomes taller and larger.
She sat on a soft blanket covered with flower petals and snow, took out a pen and paper, and wrote down her experience and insights on sword practice at the moment, as well as the mental skills Han Jiuxiao gained in Wanxiang Tower.
Everything was fine before, but when Li Wan wanted to write Han Jiuxiao, she felt a sudden pain in her heart.
A huge panic enveloped her heart, and her six senses told her that if she continued to write, there would be terrible consequences that she could not bear.
This is a warning from deep within the soul.
The pen tip paused and no longer tried to continue writing.
As the largest sect in the East, Li Wan was amazed by many things about the Xianglu Sect, but what impressed Li Wan the most so far.
That must be the magic circle.
In the Xianglu Sect, magic circles can be seen everywhere. The mentality of recruiting new disciples is the magic circle. The sect's head is surrounded by a magic circle all day long. The role of that ring must be more than just a gate. There is still a magic circle in the Wanxiang Tower.
Wherever Li Wan didn't touch, there must be magic circles everywhere.
Li Wan did not have a God's perspective, and did not have enough information to compare the two sects, Xianglu Sect and Liulin Sect, which one had stronger magic circle ability.
But judging from the fact that he was able to break through the Liulin Sect's sect's prohibition to pass on information, and tried to record Han Jiuxiao on paper but triggered a soul warning, the Xianglu Sect's attainments in the magic circle's prohibition were probably far superior to the Liulin Sect's.
However, she had clearly written down and mailed what she had learned in the course before, but this did not cause her any discomfort.
Is it because the teaching content she wrote down came from the classroom, but it contained a lot of her personal indirect thoughts?
The last time she sent a courier, she was hesitating whether to ask her family to change the Chaos Mind Technique, the Tianyuan True Secret Technique, or the Five Elements Mind Technique, so she hadn't sent the Tianyuan True Secret Technique back yet, so it didn't trigger a warning.
Li Wan put a hand on her chin and frowned. She couldn't understand the difference for a moment, but she stopped trying to pass the Xianglu Sect's skills back to her..
Dixing's safety is greater than any resources, and she will be cautious about any express delivery related to the Xianglu Sect in the future.
